protocol.purpose: User-requested distinct loss-focused follow-up to the uncertain +0.231481pp result; preserve original failed gates and source.
protocol.policy: Filter the immutable v1 proposal, never move its wall. Decline any positive-damage direct attack availability. Price the existing native one-turn path bank for visible eligible enemy ground units and own units without remaining ranged/damaging-spell output, including flyers on the own side. Require one pressured enemy best-approach and preserved equally good approaches without extra burns for every considered ally. At most20 route units. No hidden inputs, RNG or live mutation. Full-R2 new-wall selection additionally requires a strict0.01 lead over the best ordinary attack/non-wall spell, with both full samples complete. Preserve all ordinary candidates and their forecasts; mask only the extra wall from selection when the opportunity gate fails.
protocol.routeLimitations: Current native route-bank coverage, not a fresh hypothetical path search or future-policy prediction. Repricing existing routes can miss newly useful detours. Chebyshev footprint distance is a progress proxy, not actual contact/attack value. Remaining units move and spells expire; no such future facts are assumed.
protocol.population: Legal candidate Nightmare-preference drafts, native current V3/contextual default opponent and ranked setup. Same frozen generator as previous study; targeted, not global default strength.
protocol.selection: First4 Nightmare rosters per pick order per map/own-doctrine/opponent-doctrine stratum from96 fixed roster-only draft attempts. 216 independent families; no outcome selection.
protocol.admission: All65 previously changed trajectories, including every old gain/loss/null. Old cross-host control equality is reported diagnostically; same-host off/observer and all cold traces must match exactly. No admission outcomes contribute to fresh strength.
protocol.admissionCoverage: At least one actual additional v2 comparison; fail closed without fresh battles otherwise. No candidate tuning after admission outcomes.
protocol.scoring: Win1 draw0.5 loss0. Four pair differences averaged per family; equal family weighting. Preserve all native outcomes.
protocol.interval: 20,000 whole-family bootstrap draws, Python Random73117720. Primary two contrasts use simultaneous95% Bonferroni percentile endpoints1.25%/98.75%; original-v1 versusoff diagnostic uses ordinary95%. Independent exact empirical bootstrap convolution verifies endpoints.
developmentGates: at least10 v2 changed trajectories against off across2 maps
at least3 actually selected v2 walls across2 maps
strictly positive point estimate and simultaneous95% lower bound for both v2-off and v2-v1
nonnegative each own-doctrine mean for both primary contrasts
protocol.effectThreshold: No extra half-point minimum for this distinct follow-up: user values gains around0.23pp. Positive independent statistical bounds are still required; original study gates remain unchanged.
protocol.promotion: No automatic adoption. Passing development permits separately registered independent confirmation and serial serving-cost checks within+10%.
